_comment: Org rulesets, set by apply-rules.py and checked by verify-settings.py (design 6.4). A 'workflows' rule names its workflow by 'repository' (this org's repo) instead of GitHub's numeric id; rules.desired_org_rulesets() fills the id in, and applies each ruleset to every repo in repos.txt. Other org rulesets are left alone and listed as a note.
